This quest [3098] is called 'Training in the Forest'.
The head park keeper is the master in charge of this quest.
While many adventurers who come to the Forest choose to join the battle
between the twin Orders, there are also other tasks one can seek out. 
Available Marks can be viewed via 'MARK WHERE', and some are listed in
this quest's phases. There are also [Bosses] to be found here, but the
lone adventurer might find him or herself slain rather quickly.

You can find:
* Samara                    - near the banks of Rune River
* The Queen of the Dark     - deep in the Ant Hill.
* The sycophantic goblin    - anywhere in the Forest, wandering.
* The bird village          - in the northern part of the Forest.
* Sombar                    - in the northeast corner of Rune Park.
* Star fragments            - in the abandoned village, the Desolation,
                              and the other two anywhere in the Forest.
* The bloodied groom        - near the abandoned village to the northwest
 
This quest can be turned in at the head park keeper in Rune Park.
Upon successful completion of this quest the Quest Master will show
notable appreciation for your efforts.
This quest has no time limit.
Training in the Forest consists of:
Phase 1: *Seek out Samara, guardian of the bridge, and pass his trial.
Phase 2: *Journey deep into the Ant Hill, and seek out the Queen of the Dark.
Phase 3: *Display your charisma and prowess to a certain sycophantic goblin.
Phase 4: *Recover the four star fragments, and take them to Jeria.
Phase 5: *Undertake an errand for Sombar.
Phase 6: *Assist a bloodied groom from the destroyed village.
*You are on 1 of 99 maximum simultaneous SPECIAL quests.
